title: Normalized strict-local infinitesimal cohomology tower for formal functions
statement: For a scheme $Y$ [def-pc-scheme], an algebraic space $X$ and map $f:X\to Y$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and an algebraically closed geometric point $\bar y$ [def-weil-geometric-point], let $A$ and the module germ functor be the normalized ring and module colimits of pointed affine etale neighbourhoods [def-sfb-space-geometric-stalk-models]. A strict-local infinitesimal geometry consists of a local-ring structure on this $A$, a map $c:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ equal on every affine pointed neighbourhood to its colimit germ map followed by its structure map, and spaces $X_n$ with both projections forming the pullback of $f$ along $\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^{n+1})\to Y$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Consecutive transitions commute with both projections and the specified quotient-ring maps. Index $n\in\mathbb N$ denotes exponent $n+1$, so no exponent-zero fibre is included. Put $\widehat A=\operatorname{AdicCompletion}_{\mathfrak m}A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. For an original module $F$, its finite-level complex is actual ordinary tensor pullback of $F[0]$ [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Use the existing small-model right derived module direct image [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus], affine module global sections [def-sfb-space-affine-hom-comparison], and completed scalars acting on each finite level by reduction $\widehat A\to A/\mathfrak m^{n+1}$. All derived categories are the standard localizations [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], on the actual equivalent small ringed models. The canonical map $F[0]\to Ri_{n,*}(i_n^*F)[0]$ is the derived-adjunction unit followed by the right image of the existing comparison from total derived tensor pullback to actual ordinary pullback [def-sfb-space-base-change-comparisons]; no flatness of $i_n$ is assumed. Tensor transitivity [def-sfb-space-module-tensor-composition] supplies the identification of consecutive restrictions. Pushforward composition is the right-adjoint conjugate, through the normalized derived adjunctions [def-sfb-space-affine-hom-comparison], of the canonical derived pullback composition [def-sfb-space-derived-pullback]. A normalized cohomology presentation records exactness of the existing geometric-stalk functor, the ordinary stalk/finite-sections and consecutive sections/direct-image compositors, and their derived compositors. The ordinary stalk compositor is required to send a germ to its direct-image projection on every finite-fibre chart lying over the canonical map to the pointed neighbourhood; the consecutive compositor is required to preserve every iterated chart projection. Their derived compositors satisfy the square with these ordinary compositors and the fixed right-derived units on every K-injective complex. Original-site modules use the existing sheafification structures [def-sfb-space-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Define $M_q$ by applying the geometric stalk to $H^q(Rf_*F[0])$, and $H_{n,q}$ by $H^q$ of actual derived affine module global sections of the finite-level complex, with its $\widehat A$ action. Define $r_{n,q}:M_q\to H_{n,q}$ by these derived unit/compositor maps and exact-stalk homology compatibility; define $H_{n+1,q}\to H_{n,q}$ by the same derived restriction and tensor transitivity, and define the inverse system using these consecutive arrows. These structures specify the canonical maps by their chart and derived-unit equations; they assert no existence or isomorphism of the formal-functions map.
